svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Outreach
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutory-risk-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Outreach; subtitle: Proceed on documented facts; remediate or exclude unsupported activities.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate ordered decision nodes, not legal-risk scores. Each node has an explicit proceed branch and a remediation branch. Apply the cited federal rules together with relevant state requirements, contract terms, and the actual channel and sector. A business audience does not automatically remove privacy or outreach obligations.; caption: A data license, an email address, or a flat-fee label alone does not establish that the proposed activity is permitted.; stages: label: Privacy and provenance; value: Proceed with documented permitted use; otherwise quarantine records.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Evaluate California Civil Code 1798.100 and 1798.140 where applicable, including covered-business status, collection notices, purposes, and data relationships. Proceed when sourcing and use are supported; otherwise exclude the records until deficiencies are resolved.; label: Commercial email controls; value: Proceed with compliant sender controls; otherwise repair campaign setup.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704 to commercial email, including accurate headers, nondeceptive subjects, required identification, a valid postal address, and an opt-out mechanism. Honor opt-outs within ten business days. Proceed after checks pass; otherwise pause affected sends.; label: Telephone and text permissions; value: Proceed with channel-specific evidence; otherwise disable affected outreach.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Evaluate 47 U.S.C. 227 and 47 CFR 64.1200 against number type, dialing technology, artificial or prerecorded voice use, purpose, consent requirements, calling times, and do-not-call duties. Proceed only for supported uses; otherwise remove calls or texts from the sequence.; label: Sector and fee restrictions; value: Proceed with permitted compensation; otherwise exclude or redesign scope.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Screen healthcare referrals under 42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b(b), covered settlement-service referrals under 12 U.S.C. 2607, and federal procurement compensation under FAR 3.402 and 52.203-5 where applicable. Proceed only with supported fee terms and written attribution rules; otherwise exclude the activity or obtain a reviewed alternative.

circle.title: label: Privacy and provenance; value: Proceed with documented permitted use; otherwise quarantine records.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Evaluate California Civil Code 1798.100 and 1798.140 where applicable, including covered-business status, collection notices, purposes, and data relationships. Proceed when sourcing and use are supported; otherwise exclude the records until deficiencies are resolved.

text.title: Evaluate California Civil Code 1798.100 and 1798.140 where applicable, including covered-business status, collection notices, purposes, and data relationships. Proceed when sourcing and use are supported; otherwise exclude the records until deficiencies are resolved.

circle.title: label: Commercial email controls; value: Proceed with compliant sender controls; otherwise repair campaign setup.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704 to commercial email, including accurate headers, nondeceptive subjects, required identification, a valid postal address, and an opt-out mechanism. Honor opt-outs within ten business days. Proceed after checks pass; otherwise pause affected sends.

text.title: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704 to commercial email, including accurate headers, nondeceptive subjects, required identification, a valid postal address, and an opt-out mechanism. Honor opt-outs within ten business days. Proceed after checks pass; otherwise pause affected sends.

circle.title: label: Telephone and text permissions; value: Proceed with channel-specific evidence; otherwise disable affected outreach.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Evaluate 47 U.S.C. 227 and 47 CFR 64.1200 against number type, dialing technology, artificial or prerecorded voice use, purpose, consent requirements, calling times, and do-not-call duties. Proceed only for supported uses; otherwise remove calls or texts from the sequence.

text.title: Evaluate 47 U.S.C. 227 and 47 CFR 64.1200 against number type, dialing technology, artificial or prerecorded voice use, purpose, consent requirements, calling times, and do-not-call duties. Proceed only for supported uses; otherwise remove calls or texts from the sequence.

circle.title: label: Sector and fee restrictions; value: Proceed with permitted compensation; otherwise exclude or redesign scope.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Screen healthcare referrals under 42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b(b), covered settlement-service referrals under 12 U.S.C. 2607, and federal procurement compensation under FAR 3.402 and 52.203-5 where applicable. Proceed only with supported fee terms and written attribution rules; otherwise exclude the activity or obtain a reviewed alternative.

text.title: Screen healthcare referrals under 42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b(b), covered settlement-service referrals under 12 U.S.C. 2607, and federal procurement compensation under FAR 3.402 and 52.203-5 where applicable. Proceed only with supported fee terms and written attribution rules; otherwise exclude the activity or obtain a reviewed alternative.

Assumptions: Numeric values indicate ordered decision nodes, not legal-risk scores. Each node has an explicit proceed branch and a remediation branch. Apply the cited federal rules together with relevant state requirements, contract terms, and the actual channel and sector. A business audience does not automatically remove privacy or outreach obligations.
